# Nova API — /api/destinations

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/destinations`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/destinations

Operation id `destinations_list`: in Python `client.call("destinations_list", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api destinations_list`.

`GET /api/destinations` — the caller's groups' destinations, newest first.

The notification destinations of the caller's groups, newest first. `?group=<group>` narrows to one group the caller belongs to. Times are epoch milliseconds.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | query | string | No | Only this group's destinations |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The caller's groups' destinations |
| `403` | The caller is not a member of the requested group |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## POST /api/destinations

Operation id `destinations_create`: in Python `client.call("destinations_create", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api destinations_create`.

`POST /api/destinations` — `201` with the stored row.

Create a notification destination for one of the caller's groups. An `email` destination carries `config.recipients` (1 to 20 addresses); a `webhook` destination carries `config.url` (http or https). Nothing here sends anything.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | any | Yes |  | The kind's address: `{"recipients": [...]}` or `{"url": "https://…"}`. |  |
| `kind` | string | Yes |  |  |  |
| `name` | string | Yes |  |  |  |
| `owner_group` | string | Yes |  |  |  |
| `viewers` | array of string | No |  |  |  |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `201` | The stored row |
| `400` | The kind, the address, the name or the group is not valid |
| `403` | The caller is not a member of the owner group |
| `409` | A destination with this name already exists in the group |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## DELETE /api/destinations/\{id\}

Operation id `destinations_remove`: in Python `client.call("destinations_remove", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api destinations_remove`.

`DELETE /api/destinations/{id}` — `204`; `404` for another group's id or none.

Delete one of the caller's groups' notification destinations.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The destination's id |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Deleted |
| `400` | The id is not a number |
| `404` | No such destination, or it is not the caller's |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## POST /api/destinations/\{id\}/test

Operation id `destinations_test`: in Python `client.call("destinations_test", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api destinations_test`.

`POST /api/destinations/{id}/test` — send one test message to a webhook destination and record the attempt.

Send one test message to a webhook destination and record the attempt. An email destination answers 400 until the platform's SMTP relay exists. The answer never contains the webhook's URL.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The destination's id |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | What the attempt did |
| `400` | An email destination, or a config without a usable url |
| `404` | No such destination, or it is not the caller's |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |
